integrity_note: Direct analytic proof and reproducible standard-library numerical tests; no independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The two individually sharp moduli sum to a sufficient bound; the simultaneous two-parameter sum is not proved jointly sharp.
Fixed Q, A, C are assumed; variable non-diagonal blocks or finite precision require separate analysis.
The inexact Newton residual bound requires invertibility and a lower singular-value estimate of the frozen matrix.
Full historical-priority confirmation was not possible; a later same-method manuscript and parts of older smoothing literature remain unread.
title: Sharp two-scale sensitivity of algebraic-softplus interior-point Newton matrices
